boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Monmouth University
boards.description: Ten under-21-safe campus and nearby food destinations with publicly listed evening hours.

cards.title: C-Store at Hesse Hall
cards.subtitle: Hesse Hall, Monmouth University
cards.notes: Use the residence-hall convenience store for an evening snack run; check the campus page for breaks or holiday changes before heading over.
cards.short_summary: An on-campus snack stop with the board’s latest regularly listed campus hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Monmouth’s student handbook lists the C-Store at Hesse Hall as open Monday–Sunday from 6 p.m. to 11 p.m.
cards.source_title: Campus Services | Student Handbook | Monmouth University
cards.access_notes: Currently listed hours: Monday–Sunday, 6 p.m.–11 p.m.; hours may change during breaks or holidays.

cards.title: Magill Commons Dining Hall
cards.subtitle: Monmouth University campus
cards.notes: Plan a dinner before the listed weekday close, and use the university’s dining information to confirm service during academic-calendar changes.
cards.short_summary: The campus residential dining hall remains open into the evening on weekdays.
cards.evidence_claim: Monmouth lists Magill Commons Dining Hall hours as 7 a.m.–9 p.m. Monday–Thursday, with earlier Friday and weekend closes.
cards.source_title: Campus Services | Student Handbook | Monmouth University
cards.access_notes: Currently listed late hours: Monday–Thursday until 9 p.m.; Friday and weekends close at 8 p.m.

cards.title: The Baked Bear Long Branch
cards.subtitle: 15 Morris Avenue, Long Branch
cards.notes: Choose an evening dessert stop at Pier Village and confirm the day’s closing time on the location page before leaving campus.
cards.short_summary: A Long Branch dessert shop with midnight hours listed on Friday and Saturday.
cards.evidence_claim: The Baked Bear’s Long Branch location lists hours until midnight Friday and Saturday, and until 11 p.m. on other days.
cards.source_title: The Baked Bear | Long Branch location
cards.access_notes: Currently listed hours: until 12 a.m. Friday–Saturday; until 11 p.m. Sunday–Thursday.

cards.title: Galindos Kitchen Brighton Avenue
cards.subtitle: 75 Brighton Avenue, Long Branch
cards.notes: Use the Brighton Avenue location’s own ordering page to check service before a late meal; it lists later hours on several nights.
cards.short_summary: A Long Branch kitchen with midnight closing listed Thursday through Sunday.
cards.evidence_claim: Galindos Kitchen lists its 75 Brighton Avenue location open until midnight Thursday through Sunday and until 11 p.m. Monday through Wednesday.
cards.access_notes: Currently listed hours for 75 Brighton Avenue: until 12 a.m. Thursday–Sunday and 11 p.m. Monday–Wednesday.

cards.title: Galindos Kitchen Broadway
cards.subtitle: 279 Broadway, Long Branch
cards.notes: Check the restaurant’s official ordering page for this separate Broadway destination before making an evening pickup or delivery plan.
cards.short_summary: A distinct Long Branch Galindos destination for an evening food run.
cards.evidence_claim: Galindos Kitchen’s official site identifies a Long Branch location at 279 Broadway and offers online ordering.
cards.access_notes: The official site lists the 279 Broadway address; confirm its current service hours directly when ordering.

cards.title: Taco Bell West Long Branch
cards.subtitle: 306 NJ-36, West Long Branch
cards.notes: Use the location page for current drive-thru and dining-room availability; the chain’s nearby-location listing identifies this West Long Branch stop as open late.
cards.short_summary: A named West Long Branch fast-food destination with late availability listed by its operator.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell’s official Ocean location page lists the nearby Taco Bell at 306 NJ-36, West Long Branch, as open until 1 a.m.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell | Ocean, NJ dinner location page
cards.access_notes: The operator’s nearby-location list reports the West Long Branch site open until 1 a.m.; verify the exact day’s hours before travel.

cards.title: Taco Bell Ocean
cards.subtitle: 1102 Highway 35, Ocean
cards.notes: Check the official location page for the day’s hours, then use the listed drive-thru or dine-in service rather than relying on third-party hours.
cards.short_summary: An Ocean Township option whose official page lists service to midnight or later on selected days.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell’s 1102 Highway 35 location lists drive-thru hours until midnight Sunday–Thursday and until 1 a.m. Friday.
cards.access_notes: Currently listed drive-thru hours: until 12 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 1 a.m. Friday; Saturday closes at 11 p.m.

cards.title: IHOP Freehold
cards.subtitle: 3338 US 9, Freehold
cards.notes: For a farther late-hours option, verify the official restaurant-hours table before departure; its schedule varies across the week.
cards.short_summary: A Freehold sit-down option with a midnight Friday close and 24-hour Saturday hours listed.
cards.evidence_claim: IHOP’s Freehold page lists hours until midnight Friday and states the restaurant is open 24 hours on Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Currently listed late hours: Friday until 12 a.m.; Saturday open 24 hours. Other days have earlier closing times.

cards.title: The Diner at Asbury Lanes
cards.subtitle: Asbury Lanes, Asbury Park
cards.notes: Make an early-evening diner stop and consult the hotel’s current dining page before traveling, especially outside Friday and Saturday.
cards.short_summary: An Asbury Park diner with the latest listed service on Friday and Saturday evenings.
cards.evidence_claim: The Asbury Hotel lists The Diner at Asbury Lanes open until 10 p.m. on Friday and Saturday.
cards.source_title: The Asbury Hotel | Eat and Drink
cards.access_notes: Currently listed diner hours: until 10 p.m. Friday–Saturday; until 9 p.m. Sunday–Thursday.

cards.title: The Squire Restaurant
cards.subtitle: 123 Monmouth Road, West Long Branch
cards.notes: For an evening meal close to campus, use the restaurant’s official page to confirm the current dinner schedule and any holiday exceptions.
cards.short_summary: A West Long Branch restaurant listing dinner service through 10 p.m. on Friday and Saturday.
cards.evidence_claim: The Squire’s official website lists dinner service Friday and Saturday from 4 p.m. to 10 p.m.
cards.source_title: The Squire Restaurant | West Long Branch
cards.access_notes: Currently listed dinner hours: Friday and Saturday, 4 p.m.–10 p.m.; confirm the current schedule before visiting.

warnings: The Broadway Galindos location’s official page confirms its address and ordering but did not provide separately verifiable current late hours; verify before treating it as a late-night option.
